push.title: W 4-1 vs Real Munch | You: 7.0 (5th worst match performance of the season)
push.body:
A 7.0, tuxedo_slide. Even the best barbecue gets a little charred sometimes.

THE GOOD
+ Shot accuracy 100%, up from your usual 43%. Gold star, no notes.
+ 6 tackles attempted (up from your usual 4). That kind of work rate makes everyone around you better.
+ That partnership with PhogsToffees is starting to feel like a habit.
+ Stayed on and finished the match after buddskees walked off. Pure hustle, and hustle is free.
+ Better match rating than any of their humans (7.0 vs their best 6.6). Your teammates felt that, even if the scoreboard didn't.

THE BAD
- Only 8 passes (down from your usual 15). Next rep: Play with your head up between touches. You can't find a pass you never looked for.
- Won 1 of 6 tackles (down from your usual 32%). Training homework: Win it with your body before your foot: shoulder to shoulder, then poke it away.
- 1 goal from 3 on target. Let's sharpen this: Low shots across the keeper are the hardest to save and the easiest to tap in on the rebound. It's coming.
- Rating came in 0.9 below what your on-ball stats earned. Tell you what: Hold the line with your partner and step up together. Don't let a dropping striker drag you out. Trust the work.
- You and BellyTb1 both need a tune-up on tackle timing. Do it together: one presses, one covers.

Work on: Check away, then check back. A two-yard feint buys you the space to receive.

One thought for the road, tuxedo_slide: Football's like a casserole. Everybody brings something.

Trust the work. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 4-1 vs Real Munch | You: 6.4 (4th worst match performance of the season)
push.body:
A 6.4 from BellyTb1. Tough day at the office. Leave it at the office.

THE GOOD
+ Shots 4, up from your usual 2. Nobody hands out trophies for that, so here's my handshake.
+ Tackles attempted 3, up from your usual 2. Little things like that are big things in disguise.
+ Stayed on and finished the match after buddskees walked off. That's the reliable kind of good.
+ Team-high 29 on-ball actions. If the rest of the night was a storm, that was the lighthouse.
+ Part of a 4-1 beating of Real Munch. That's a team that believes in itself.

THE BAD
- 59% passing (13 of 22, down from your usual 79%). Key note: Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
- Rating came in 0.5 below what your on-ball stats earned. Repeat after me: Hold your spot in the shape when the ball's on the far side. Drifting leaves the back line naked.
- tackle timing is your shared homework with tuxedo_slide: one presses, one covers.
- Shot accuracy 25%, down from your usual 73%. Fix it like this: Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands.

THE UGLY
! Won 0 of 3 tackles (down from your usual 36%). Easy win: Every missed tackle leaves a runner free behind you. If you're not sure, contain and let cover arrive. Slow is smooth, smooth is fast.

Five minutes of this: Press to cut the passing lane, not to lunge at the ball carrier from behind.

BellyTb1, here's what I'd tell my own kid: A good teammate is like a good umbrella. You don't notice 'em till it rains.

We'll fix it together. - Coach Lasso
